name: canal-ring
source: 3D BAG (tudelft3d + 3DGI), v20250903, BAG footprints + AHN point clouds, CC BY 4.0
heightsNote: Height = 70th-percentile roof elevation minus ground level, both NAP metres (3D BAG v20250903: lod12_2d b3_h_70p minus pand b3_h_maaiveld; ground is the 5th percentile of AHN ground points within 4 m of the building). A building cut into parts is emitted one row per part. Footprints: BAG polygons, exterior ring only, simplified to 0.5 m in the local frame, rings under 4.0 m2 dropped, clipped by centroid. Null heights or b3_pw_onvoldoende take the shared 2.5 m fill (hSource 'fill'). RD New to WGS84 via pyproj operation 'Inverse of RD New + Amersfoort to WGS 84 (4) (with axis order normalized for visualization)' (stated accuracy 1 m). © 3DBAG by tudelft3d and 3DGI (CC BY 4.0); modified as stated.
